name: logo-cloud-01
title: Logo Cloud 01 - A Grid Of Customer Marks
description: A grid of customer or partner marks, each one a slot the caller fills with the mark, the name and an optional destination. The marks are muted rather than recoloured, every mark carries its name in a hidden node, and there is no scrolling form: the marquee is refused by name. Every mark and every name is passed in as a prop.
